<issue>Issue Title: [FEATURE] Support `strict: true` on tool definitions in BedrockModel
Description:
## Overview
Bedrock's Converse API supports a `strict` field on `ToolSpecification` ([API docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolSpecification.html)) that enables schema validation on tool names and inputs ([structured output docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/structured-output.html)). This prevents the model from hallucinating tool names or generating inputs that don't match the defined schema.
Currently there's no way to enable this through the SDK because `BedrockModel._format_request` only forwards `name`, `description`, and `inputSchema` from each tool spec, and `additional_request_fields`/`additional_args` operate at the top-level request, not inside individual `toolSpec` objects.
### Use Case
Tool name hallucination in production — the model occasionally generates garbled tool names (e.g. `store-case-syummary-tool` instead of `store-case-summary-tool`). The agent self-corrects on the next cycle, but it wastes a cycle and extra tokens. The `strict: true` flag eliminates this class of error entirely.
---
## Implementation Requirements
Based on clarification discussion and repository analysis:
### Approach
Add a `strict_tools` config option to `BedrockConfig` that applies `strict: true` to **all** tool specs in the request. This is a model-level blanket toggle — per-tool granularity is tracked separately in #1642 / PR #1862.
```python
model = BedrockModel(
model_id="us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6",
strict_tools=True,
)
```
### Files to Modify
1. **`src/strands/models/bedrock.py`**
- Add `strict_tools: bool | None` to `BedrockConfig` TypedDict with appropriate docstring
- Update `_format_request` to inject `"strict": True` into each `toolSpec` dict when `strict_tools` is enabled:
```python
"toolSpec": {
"name": tool_spec["name"],
"description": tool_spec["description"],
"inputSchema": tool_spec["inputSchema"],
**({"strict": True} if self.config.get("strict_tools") else {}),
}
```
- Add a warning log when `strict_tools=True` is used alongside citations configuration (Bedrock docs state structured outputs is incompatible with citations for Anthropic models)
2. **`tests/strands/models/test_bedrock.py`**
- Test that `strict_tools=True` injects `"strict": True` into each `toolSpec` in the formatted request
- Test that default behavior (no `strict_tools` or `strict_tools=None`) does NOT include `strict` in tool specs
- Test that `strict_tools=False` does NOT include `strict` in tool specs
- Test the citations incompatibility warning is emitted when appropriate
### What NOT to change
- **Do NOT modify `ToolSpec` TypedDict** in `src/strands/types/tools.py` — per-tool `strict` field is handled by #1642 / PR #1862
- **No GitHub workflow changes** needed
- **No changes to other model providers** — this is Bedrock-specific
### Interaction with PR #1862
If PR #1862 (per-tool `strict` on `ToolSpec`) lands before or after this feature:
- `strict_tools` on `BedrockConfig` acts as a model-level default
- Per-tool `strict` on individual `ToolSpec` entries could override the model-level setting in a future follow-up
- For this PR, only the model-level `strict_tools` config needs to be implemented
### Important Bedrock Behavior Notes
- First-time schema compilation for a new schema may take up to a few minutes
- Subsequently, cached grammars are used (24-hour TTL)
- Structured outputs is **incompatible with citations** for Anthropic models
### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `BedrockConfig` accepts `strict_tools` as an optional boolean parameter
- [ ] When `strict_tools=True`, all `toolSpec` objects in the formatted request include `"strict": true`
- [ ] When `strict_tools` is not set, `None`, or `False`, tool specs do NOT include a `strict` field
- [ ] A warning is logged when `strict_tools=True` is used alongside citations configuration
- [ ] Unit tests cover all scenarios (enabled, disabled, default, citations warning)
- [ ] Existing tests continue to pass
- [ ] Code follows repository conventions (type annotations, Google-style docstrings, structured logging)
</issue>

326         Args:

392     def _format_bedrock_messages(self, messages: Messages) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
393         """Format messages for Bedrock API compatibility.
394 
395         This function ensures messages conform to Bedrock's expected format by:
396         - Filtering out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
397         - Eagerly filtering content blocks to only include Bedrock-supported fields
398         - Ensuring all message content blocks are properly formatted for the Bedrock API
399         - Optionally wrapping the last user message in guardrailConverseContent blocks
400         - Injecting cache points when cache_config is set with strategy="auto"
401 
402         Args:
403             messages: List of messages to format
404 
405         Returns:
406             Messages formatted for Bedrock API compatibility
407 
408         Note:
409             Unlike other APIs that ignore unknown fields, Bedrock only accepts a strict
410             subset of fields for each content block type and throws validation exceptions
411             when presented with unexpected fields. Therefore, we must eagerly filter all
412             content blocks to remove any additional fields before sending to Bedrock.
413             https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ContentBlock.html
414         """
415         cleaned_messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
416 
417         filtered_unknown_members = False
418         dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = False
419 
420         # Pre-compute the index of the last user message containing text or image content.
421         # This ensures guardContent wrapping is maintained across tool execution cycles, where
422         # the final message in the list is a toolResult (role=user) rather than text/image content.
423         last_user_text_idx = None
424         if self.config.get("guardrail_latest_message", False):
425             last_user_text_idx = self._find_last_user_text_message_index(messages)
426 
427         for idx, message in enumerate(messages):
428             cleaned_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
429 
430             for content_block in message["content"]:
431                 # Filter out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
432                 if "SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER" in content_block:
433                     filtered_unknown_members = True
434                     continue
435 
436                 # DeepSeek models have issues with reasoningContent
437                 # TODO: Replace with systematic model configuration registry (https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/780)
438                 if "deepseek" in self.config["model_id"].lower() and "reasoningContent" in content_block:
439                     dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = True
440                     continue
441 
442                 # Format content blocks for Bedrock API compatibility
443                 formatted_content = self._format_request_message_content(content_block)
444                 if formatted_content is None:
445                     continue
446 
447                 # Wrap text or image content in guardContent if this is the last user text/image message
448                 if idx == last_user_text_idx and ("text" in formatted_content or "image" in formatted_content):
449                     if "text" in formatted_content:
450                         formatted_content = {"guardContent": {"text": {"text": formatted_content["text"]}}}
451                     elif "image" in formatted_content:
452                         formatted_content = {"guardContent": {"image": formatted_content["image"]}}
453 
454                 cleaned_content.append(formatted_content)
455 
456             # Create new message with cleaned content (skip if empty)
457             if cleaned_content:
458                 cleaned_messages.append({"content": cleaned_content, "role": message["role"]})
459 
460         if filtered_unknown_members:
461             logger.warning(
462                 "Filtered out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks from messages, consider upgrading boto3 version"
463             )
464         if dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content:
465             logger.debug(
466                 "Filtered DeepSeek reasoningContent content blocks from messages - https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model#multi-round-conversation"
467             )
468 
469         # Inject cache point into cleaned_messages (not original messages) if cache_config is set
470         cache_config = self.config.get("cache_config")
471         if cache_config:
472             strategy: str | None = cache_config.strategy
473             if strategy == "auto":
474                 strategy = self._cache_strategy
475                 if not strategy:
476                     logger.warning(
477                         "model_id=<%s> | cache_config is enabled but this model does not support automatic caching",
478                         self.config.get("model_id"),
479                     )
480             if strategy == "anthropic":
481                 self._inject_cache_point(cleaned_messages)
482 
483         return cleaned_messages
484

508     def _format_request_message_content(self, content: ContentBlock) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
509         """Format a Bedrock content block.
510 
511         Bedrock strictly validates content blocks and throws exceptions for unknown fields.
512         This function extracts only the fields that Bedrock supports for each content type.
513 
514         Args:
515             content: Content block to format.
516 
517         Returns:
518             Bedrock formatted content block.
519 
520         Raises:
521             TypeError: If the content block type is not supported by Bedrock.
522         """
523         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_CachePointBlock.html
524         if "cachePoint" in content:
525             cache_point = content["cachePoint"]
526             result: dict[str, Any] = {"type": cache_point["type"]}
527             if "ttl" in cache_point:
528                 result["ttl"] = cache_point["ttl"]
529             return {"cachePoint": result}
530 
531         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_DocumentBlock.html
532         if "document" in content:
533             document = content["document"]
534             result = {}
535 
536             # Handle required fields (all optional due to total=False)
537             if "name" in document:
538                 result["name"] = document["name"]
539             if "format" in document:
540                 result["format"] = document["format"]
541 
542             # Handle source - supports bytes or location
543             if "source" in document:
544                 source = document["source"]
545                 formatted_document_source: dict[str, Any] | None
546                 if "location" in source:
547                     formatted_document_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
548                     if formatted_document_source is None:
549                         return None
550                 elif "bytes" in source:
551                     formatted_document_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
552                 result["source"] = formatted_document_source
553 
554             # Handle optional fields
555             if "citations" in document and document["citations"] is not None:
556                 result["citations"] = {"enabled": document["citations"]["enabled"]}
557             if "context" in document:
558                 result["context"] = document["context"]
559 
560             return {"document": result}
561 
562         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_GuardrailConverseContentBlock.html
563         if "guardContent" in content:
564             guard = content["guardContent"]
565             guard_text = guard["text"]
566             result = {"text": {"text": guard_text["text"], "qualifiers": guard_text["qualifiers"]}}
567             return {"guardContent": result}
568 
569         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ImageBlock.html
570         if "image" in content:
571             image = content["image"]
572             source = image["source"]
573             formatted_image_source: dict[str, Any] | None
574             if "location" in source:
575                 formatted_image_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
576                 if formatted_image_source is None:
577                     return None
578             elif "bytes" in source:
579                 formatted_image_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
580             result = {"format": image["format"], "source": formatted_image_source}
581             return {"image": result}
582 
583         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ReasoningContentBlock.html
584         if "reasoningContent" in content:
585             reasoning = content["reasoningContent"]
586             result = {}
587 
588             if "reasoningText" in reasoning:
589                 reasoning_text = reasoning["reasoningText"]
590                 result["reasoningText"] = {}
591                 if "text" in reasoning_text:
592                     result["reasoningText"]["text"] = reasoning_text["text"]
593                 # Only include signature if truthy (avoid empty strings)
594                 if reasoning_text.get("signature"):
595                     result["reasoningText"]["signature"] = reasoning_text["signature"]
596 
597             if "redactedContent" in reasoning:
598                 result["redactedContent"] = reasoning["redactedContent"]
599 
600             return {"reasoningContent": result}
601 
602         # Pass through text and other simple content types
603         if "text" in content:
604             return {"text": content["text"]}
605 
606         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolResultBlock.html
607         if "toolResult" in content:
608             tool_result = content["toolResult"]
609             # Normalize empty toolResult content arrays.
610             # Some model providers (e.g., Nemotron) reject toolResult blocks with
611             # content: [] via the Converse API, while others (e.g., Claude) accept
612             # them. Replace empty content with a minimal text block to ensure
613             # cross-model compatibility. This follows the same pattern as the
614             # TypeScript SDK's _formatMessages in bedrock.ts.
615             tool_result_content_list = tool_result.get("content") or [{"text": ""}]
616             formatted_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
617             for tool_result_content in tool_result_content_list:
618                 if "json" in tool_result_content:
619                     # Handle json field since not in ContentBlock but valid in ToolResultContent
620                     formatted_content.append({"json": tool_result_content["json"]})
621                 else:
622                     formatted_message_content = self._format_request_message_content(
623                         cast(ContentBlock, tool_result_content)
624                     )
625                     if formatted_message_content is None:
626                         continue
627                     formatted_content.append(formatted_message_content)
628 
629             result = {
630                 "content": formatted_content,
631                 "toolUseId": tool_result["toolUseId"],
632             }
633             if "status" in tool_result and self._should_include_tool_result_status():
634                 result["status"] = tool_result["status"]
635             return {"toolResult": result}
636 
637         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolUseBlock.html
638         if "toolUse" in content:
639             tool_use = content["toolUse"]
640             return {
641                 "toolUse": {
642                     "input": tool_use["input"],
643                     "name": tool_use["name"],
644                     "toolUseId": tool_use["toolUseId"],
645                 }
646             }
647 
648         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_VideoBlock.html
649         if "video" in content:
650             video = content["video"]
651             source = video["source"]
652             formatted_video_source: dict[str, Any] | None
653             if "location" in source:
654                 formatted_video_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
655                 if formatted_video_source is None:
656                     return None
657             elif "bytes" in source:
658                 formatted_video_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
659             result = {"format": video["format"], "source": formatted_video_source}
660             return {"video": result}
661 
662         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_CitationsContentBlock.html
663         if "citationsContent" in content:
664             citations = content["citationsContent"]
665             result = {}
666 
667             if "citations" in citations:
668                 result["citations"] = []
669                 for citation in citations["citations"]:
670                     filtered_citation: dict[str, Any] = {}
671                     if "location" in citation:
672                         filtered_citation["location"] = citation["location"]
673                     if "sourceContent" in citation:
674                         filtered_source_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
675                         for source_content in citation["sourceContent"]:
676                             if "text" in source_content:
677                                 filtered_source_content.append({"text": source_content["text"]})
678                         if filtered_source_content:
679                             filtered_citation["sourceContent"] = filtered_source_content
680                     if "title" in citation:
681                         filtered_citation["title"] = citation["title"]
682                     result["citations"].append(filtered_citation)
683 
684             if "content" in citations:
685                 filtered_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
686                 for generated_content in citations["content"]:
687                     if "text" in generated_content:
688                         filtered_content.append({"text": generated_content["text"]})
689                 if filtered_content:
690                     result["content"] = filtered_content
691 
692             return {"citationsContent": result}
693 
694         raise TypeError(f"content_type=<{next(iter(content))}> | unsupported type")
695

821         This method calls either the Bedrock converse_stream API or the converse API
822         based on the streaming parameter in the configuration.
823 
824         Args:
825             messages: List of message objects to be processed by the model.

837             ModelThrottledException: If the model service is throttling requests.
838         """

840         def callback(event: StreamEvent | None = None) -> None:
841             loop.call_soon_threadsafe(queue.put_nowait, event)
842             if event is None:
843                 return
844 
845         loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()

849         if system_prompt and system_prompt_content is None:

853         task = asyncio.create_task(thread)
